subject: general
question: With which tech behemoth has the Indian company Infosys recently partnered to create a generative AI solution for telecom operators?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nvidia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian IT major **Infosys** announced an expanded strategic collaboration with **Nvidia** in **May 2024** to help **Telecommunications** providers worldwide accelerate their **Generative AI** (GenAI) journey.
 
• The partnership focuses on building **industry-specific solutions** that leverage **Infosys Topaz**, an AI-first set of services, platforms, and solutions, integrated with the **Nvidia AI Enterprise** software stack.
 
• The primary objective of this collaboration is to assist **Telecom Operators** (Telcos) in enhancing **Customer Experience**, optimizing network performance, and driving **Operational Excellence** through automated processes.
 
• By utilizing **Nvidia’s** advanced infrastructure and **GenAI** tools, **Infosys** aims to develop customized **Large Language Models (LLMs)** tailored to the specific technical and linguistic requirements of the global telecom industry.
 
• The solutions include **Nvidia NeMo**, a development platform for building and deploying generative AI, which helps in creating carrier-grade applications for **Business Support Systems (BSS)** and **Operations Support Systems (OSS)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Infosys Topaz:** Launched in **2023**, **Topaz** is **Infosys's** suite of AI-first offerings. It uses **Generative AI** technologies to help enterprises modernize their business models and improve productivity across various **Verticals**.
 
• **Nvidia's Role in AI:** Headquartered in **California, USA**, **Nvidia** has become a global leader in AI hardware and software. Its **Graphics Processing Units (GPUs)**, such as the **H100** and **A100**, are essential for training complex **Neural Networks**.
 
• **Generative AI in Telecom:** Common use cases for **GenAI** in this sector include **Predictive Maintenance** of network towers, **Hyper-personalized Marketing**, and **AI-powered Virtual Assistants** that resolve customer queries in real-time.
 
• **Nvidia AI Enterprise:** This is a cloud-native suite of **AI and Data Science** software that is optimized, certified, and supported by **Nvidia** to run on mainstream servers. It provides the essential building blocks for **Enterprise-grade AI**.
 
• **Industry Impact:** This partnership highlights the growing trend of **Indian IT Services** companies collaborating with global chipmakers and software giants to capture the massive **Digital Transformation** market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The collaboration was showcased at the **TM Forum’s DTW-Ignite** event in **Copenhagen** in **2024**, where both companies demonstrated the **Telco-specific GenAI** solutions.
 
• Key features of the solution include **Network Trouble Ticketing**, which uses AI to automatically categorize and suggest resolutions for network issues, reducing the **Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)**.
 
• The partnership also aims to provide **Data Privacy** and **Security**, ensuring that **Telecom** companies can deploy AI models within their own **On-premise** or private cloud environments safely.
 
• As of **2024**, **Infosys** continues to invest heavily in its **AI-first** strategy, training thousands of employees on **Nvidia’s** software platforms to build a robust **AI Workforce**.
